[9Related Reforges](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Sword_Mastery#Related_Reforges) ## Description | | | | --- | --- | | [![Sword Mastery.png](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/images/4/4a/Sword_Mastery.png)](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/File:Sword_Mastery.png) | When it comes to melee combat, swords are the weapons of choice. Sword Mastery enhances your skill with swords. While this ability doesn't grant any specific skills, it will grant you greater proficiency when you fight enemies using your trusty sword. | ## Details - Passively increases the player's minimum and maximum melee [Damage](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Damage "Damage") and [Balance](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Balance "Balance") when using [swords](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Swords_List "Swords List"). - These changes do not show on the weapon. - If a [Human](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Human "Human") player is [Dual Wielding](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Dual_Wielding "Dual Wielding"), the bonus from Sword Mastery will apply **once** despite having two swords. ## [Skill Issues](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Current_Bugs "Current Bugs") - When ranking Sword Mastery, the Balance increase is not reflected in your character's information window until you relog or change channels. Description

 When it comes to melee combat, swords are the weapons of choice. Sword Mastery enhances your skill with swords. While this ability doesn't grant any specific skills, it will grant you greater proficiency when you fight enemies using your trusty sword.

Details

  • Passively increases the player's minimum and maximum melee Damage and Balance when using swords.
    • These changes do not show on the weapon.
  • If a Human player is Dual Wielding, the bonus from Sword Mastery will apply once despite having two swords.

Skill Issues

  • When ranking Sword Mastery, the Balance increase is not reflected in your character's information window until you relog or change channels. However, the balance increase is still applied.
